name: TCL 32S5K
summary: TCL 32S5K ships with TCL promos, a cleaner app and silent partner installs. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This 32 inch TCL QLED has under 1 GB of memory, so the extra apps matter. It ships with a TCL account app, a TGuard cleaner and support app, promo rows on the stock home, a TCL web video portal and a partner app auto installer. Google extras like games and a music app add more.

The list was checked package by package on this unit, applied in three rounds and tested after reboots, including the undo and a re-apply. Netflix and YouTube played, HDMI switching worked and Wi-Fi survived. TidyTV saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Live TV, which also plays HDMI
The screensaver, unless you turn it off yourself
notes: The TCL account app can be turned back on by the TCL service. Check the app list after a restart.
On this unit free memory rose by about 56 MB with the stock home and 84 MB with a clean home screen.
Several extras, such as Google search, text-to-speech and the USB media player, are marked off by choice. Switch back on any you use.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 32S5K?
faq.a: Not with the full list, which turns off Google search and voice. Leave those switches on in the app if you use voice.
Yes. The full list was restored and applied again on this TV to test it.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off the TCL promo rows, the web video portal and the Google recommendation rows.
